1.modern-en: Mowgli is brought as a toddler to the wolf pack after fleeing Shere Khan, and Father Wolf and Raksha adopt him as their own. He grows up in the jungle under the protection of the pack, learning its laws at Baloo's and Bagheera's side.
1.modern-da: Mowgli bringes som lille barn til ulveflokken efter at have flygtet fra Shere Khan, og Fader Ulv og Raksha adopterer ham som deres eget. Han vokser op i junglen under flokkens beskyttelse og lærer dens love ved Balooes og Bagheerahs side.

2.modern-en: Mowgli is lured away by the Bandar-log monkeys and carried to the ruined city of the Cold Lairs, where he is held captive. Bagheera, Baloo, and Kaa rescue him; he is bruised and shaken but unbroken, and learns his first lesson about the true danger of those who have no law.
2.modern-da: Mowgli lokkes væk af Bandar-log-aberne og bæres til den forladte by Cold Lairs, hvor han holdes fanget. Bagheera, Baloo og Kaa redder ham; han er forslået og rystet men ikke knækket, og lærer sin første lektie om den sande fare ved dem, der ikke kender nogen lov.

3.modern-en: Mowgli is cast out of the wolf pack and returns to the village of men, where he lives with Messua and her husband. He herds buffaloes, is mocked by the village boys, and ultimately engineers Shere Khan's death by driving a stampede over him in a ravine.
3.modern-da: Mowgli udstødes af ulveflokken og vender tilbage til menneskenes landsby, hvor han bor hos Messua og hendes mand. Han vogter bøfler, hånes af landsbydrengene og udtænker til sidst Shere Khans død ved at drive en stampede hen over ham i en kløft.

epithet.en: Black panther of the jungle council

1.modern-en: Bagheera pays the price of a freshly killed bull to win the wolf pack's acceptance of Mowgli, vouching for the man-cub and becoming one of his two teachers. He is sleek, cunning, and utterly fearless.
1.modern-da: Bagheera betaler prisen på en nyligt dræbt okse for at vinde ulveflokens accept af Mowgli, går i god for menneskebarnet og bliver en af hans to lærere. Han er slank, snedig og fuldstændig frygtløs.

2.modern-en: Bagheera is captured along with Baloo when they pursue the Bandar-log to Cold Lairs. Outnumbered by the monkeys, he can only hold on until Kaa's arrival turns the tide and Mowgli is freed.
2.modern-da: Bagheera fanges sammen med Baloo, da de forfølger Bandar-log til Cold Lairs. Overvældet af aberne kan han kun holde ud, til Kaas ankomst vender kampen og Mowgli befries.

3.modern-en: Bagheera warns Mowgli that the pack's loyalty is failing and urges him to go to the man-village. After Akela's downfall, Bagheera stands beside Mowgli when the pack turns on him.
3.modern-da: Bagheera advarer Mowgli om, at flokkens loyalitet vakler, og opfordrer ham til at tage til menneskelandsbyen. Efter Akelas fald står Bagheera ved Mowglis side, da flokken vender sig mod ham.

epithet.en: The sleepy brown bear, teacher of the Law
epithet.da: Den søvnige brune bjørn, lovens lærer

1.modern-en: Baloo, the pack's teacher of the Law, speaks up for Mowgli at the council rock and vouches for his right to remain with the wolves. He undertakes to teach Mowgli the Master Words of the jungle.
1.modern-da: Baloo, flokkens lovlærer, taler for Mowgli på rådsstedet og garanterer hans ret til at forblive hos ulvene. Han påtager sig at lære Mowgli junglens mesterord.

2.modern-en: Baloo fights alongside Bagheera against the Bandar-log but is overwhelmed by their numbers at Cold Lairs. He is contrite and self-reproachful for having taught Mowgli the Master Words that the monkeys overheard and exploited to kidnap the boy.
2.modern-da: Baloo kæmper side om side med Bagheera mod Bandar-log, men overvældes af deres antal i Cold Lairs. Han er anger­fuld og selvbebrejdende, fordi han lærte Mowgli mesterordene, som aberne aflyttede og udnyttede til at bortføre drengen.

epithet.en: Lone Wolf, leader of the pack

1.modern-en: Akela leads the wolf pack and presides over the council where Mowgli's fate is decided. He protects the man-cub against Shere Khan's protests, asserting the pack's right to accept him.
1.modern-da: Akela leder ulveflokken og leder rådet, hvor Mowglis skæbne afgøres. Han beskytter menneskebarnet mod Shere Khans protester og hævder flokkens ret til at acceptere ham.

3.modern-en: Akela misses a kill and is declared a spent wolf by the pack, giving Shere Khan's faction the chance to move against both him and Mowgli. He is humiliated at the council rock, but Mowgli's intervention with the Red Flower saves him from being killed outright.
3.modern-da: Akela misser et drab og erklæres for en udslidt ulv af flokken, hvilket giver Shere Khans fraktion chancen for at handle mod både ham og Mowgli. Han ydmyges ved rådsstedet, men Mowglis indgriben med den Røde Blomst redder ham fra at blive dræbt.

epithet.en: The lame tiger, enemy of man

1.modern-en: Shere Khan arrives at the wolves' lair demanding the man-cub that fled from him, but Father Wolf and Raksha defy him, and the pack ultimately accepts Mowgli. Shere Khan declares he will have the boy in the end.
1.modern-da: Shere Khan ankommer til ulvenes hule og kræver det menneskebarn, der flygtede fra ham, men Fader Ulv og Raksha trodser ham, og flokken accepterer til sidst Mowgli. Shere Khan erklærer, at han vil have drengen til sidst.

3.modern-en: Shere Khan returns, fat and sleek from easy village kills, and conspires with disloyal wolves to depose Akela and claim Mowgli. He is lured by Mowgli into a dry ravine, where stampeding buffaloes trample him to death.
3.modern-da: Shere Khan vender tilbage, fed og velfed af lette landsbybytte, og sammensværger sig med illoyale ulve om at vælte Akela og kræve Mowgli. Han lokkes af Mowgli ind i en tør kløft, hvor stampedende bøfler tramper ham ihjel.

2.modern-en: Kaa is enlisted by Bagheera and Baloo to rescue Mowgli from the Bandar-log. He arrives at Cold Lairs and uses his hypnotic dance to paralyse the monkeys with terror, allowing the rescue to succeed.
2.modern-da: Kaa hverves af Bagheera og Baloo til at redde Mowgli fra Bandar-log. Han ankommer til Cold Lairs og bruger sin hypnotiske dans til at lamme aberne af rædsel, hvilket muliggør redningen.

1.modern-en: Tabaqui slinks to the wolves' lair ahead of Shere Khan to announce that the tiger is hunting a man-cub in the Seeonee hills. He is obsequious and malevolent in equal measure, relishing the fear he carries.
1.modern-da: Tabaqui lister til ulvenes hule foran Shere Khan for at meddele, at tigeren jager et menneskebarn i Seeonee-bjergene. Han er ydmyg og ondsindet i lige mål og nyder den frygt, han bærer med sig.

epithet.en: Head of the wolf family that adopts Mowgli
epithet.da: Overhoved for den ulvefamilie, der adopterer Mowgli

1.modern-en: Father Wolf finds the toddler Mowgli at his cave mouth, defies Shere Khan's claim, and with Raksha decides to raise the man-cub as one of their own cubs.
1.modern-da: Fader Ulv finder den lille Mowgli ved indgangen til sin hule, trodser Shere Khans krav og beslutter sammen med Raksha at opdrage menneskebarnet som et af deres egne unger.

epithet.en: Mother Wolf, fierce protector of Mowgli

1.modern-en: Raksha snarls Shere Khan into retreat, claims Mowgli as her own cub, and vows that he will hunt the tiger one day. Her ferocity in that moment is the act that saves Mowgli's life.
1.modern-da: Raksha knurrer Shere Khan på flugt, gør krav på Mowgli som sin egen unge og lover, at han en dag vil jage tigeren. Hendes vildhed i det øjeblik er den handling, der redder Mowglis liv.

epithet.en: The monkey people, without law or memory

2.modern-en: The Bandar-log kidnap Mowgli and carry him to the Cold Lairs, where they hold him captive amid boastful chatter, with no plan and no law. They are routed by Kaa's dance and scatter in panicked flight.
2.modern-da: Bandar-log bortfører Mowgli og bærer ham til Cold Lairs, hvor de holder ham fanget midt i pralende snak, uden nogen plan og ingen lov. De jages på flugt af Kaas dans og spreder sig i panisk flugt.

epithet.en: The village hunter, teller of tall tales
epithet.da: Landsbyens jæger, fortæller af store løgne

3.modern-en: Buldeo is the pompous village hunter who fills Mowgli's days with impossible tales of jungle beasts. After Shere Khan's death, Buldeo goes out to claim the tiger's skin for the bounty, but is stopped by the wolves on Mowgli's order and sent home empty-handed.
3.modern-da: Buldeo er landsbyens pralende jæger, der fylder Mowglis dage med umulige historier om junglens dyr. Efter Shere Khans død drager Buldeo ud for at hente tigerens skind for præmien, men stoppes af ulvene på Mowglis ordre og sendes hjem med tomme hænder.

epithet.en: The village woman who believes Mowgli is her lost son
epithet.da: Landsbykvinden der tror, Mowgli er hendes tabte søn

3.modern-en: Messua takes Mowgli into her home, believing he may be the son taken by a tiger years before. She is kind and patient with him as he learns to speak, and is the closest thing to a human mother he encounters.
3.modern-da: Messua tager Mowgli ind i sit hjem og tror, han måske er den søn, der blev taget af en tiger for år siden. Hun er venlig og tålmodig med ham, mens han lærer at tale, og er det tætteste på en menneskemor, han møder.

epithet.en: Little Toomai, boy who sees the elephants dance
epithet.da: Lille Toomai, drengen der ser elefanterne danse

6.modern-en: Little Toomai is the boy elephant handler who slips away at night clinging to Kala Nag's neck to witness the legendary elephant dance deep in the jungle. His experience earns him the name Toomai of the Elephants and the respect of all the mahouts.
6.modern-da: Lille Toomai er drengen, der passer elefanter, og som smutter ud om natten klyngende sig til Kala Nags nakke for at overvære den legendariske elefantdans dybt inde i junglen. Hans oplevelse giver ham navnet Toomai af Elefanterne og respekt fra alle mahoutterne.

epithet.en: The great working elephant, wisest of them all
epithet.da: Den store arbejdselefant, den klogeste af dem alle

6.modern-en: Kala Nag is the magnificent old elephant who carries Little Toomai through the night to the secret elephant dance. He is a steady, powerful presence who embodies the deep wisdom and ancient memory of his kind.
6.modern-da: Kala Nag er den pragtfulde gamle elefant, der bærer Lille Toomai gennem natten til den hemmelige elefantdans. Han er en støt, kraftfuld skikkelse, der legemliggør sin arts dybe visdom og ældgamle hukommelse.

epithet.en: The mongoose who guards a garden

5.modern-en: Rikki-tikki-tavi is swept from his burrow by a flood and taken in by a British colonial family in their garden bungalow. He kills the cobra Nag in the bathroom and then hunts down Nagaina, destroying her eggs and saving the family from the cobra pair's plot.
5.modern-da: Rikki-tikki-tavi skylles væk fra sin hule af en oversvømmelse og tages ind af en britisk kolonifamilie i deres havebungalow. Han dræber kobraslangens Nag på badeværelset og jager derefter Nagaina ned, ødelægger hendes æg og redder familien fra kobraparnets komplot.

epithet.en: The cobra pair who rule the garden by fear
epithet.da: Kobra-parret der hersker over haven ved frygt

5.modern-en: Nag and Nagaina are the king cobra and his mate who terrorise the garden and plot to kill the human family so that snakes can reclaim it. Nag is killed by Rikki-tikki in the bathroom; Nagaina fights on desperately to protect her last egg before being chased into her hole and killed.
5.modern-da: Nag og Nagaina er kongekobraslangens og hans mage, der terroriserer haven og planlægger at dræbe menneskefamilien, så slangerne kan generobre den. Nag dræbes af Rikki-tikki på badeværelset; Nagaina kæmper desperat videre for at beskytte sit sidste æg, inden hun jages ind i sit hul og dræbes.

epithet.en: The white seal who seeks a safe shore
epithet.da: Den hvide sæl der søger en sikker strand

4.modern-en: Kotick is a rare all-white seal born on the Novastoshnah beach of St. Paul's Island. Horrified by the annual slaughter of seals by hunters, he spends years searching the oceans for a safe, uncharted shore where his people can live in peace, finally finding it after a perilous journey guided by Sea Cow.
4.modern-da: Kotick er en sjælden helt hvid sæl, født på Novastoshnah-stranden på St. Pauls-øen. Rystet over den årlige slagtning af sæler af jægere bruger han år på at søge havene igennem efter en sikker, ukendt kyst, hvor hans folk kan leve i fred, og finder den til sidst efter en farlig rejse vejledt af Søko.
